messages:
noah: Noticed a scatter of GPU nodes in ap-south2 getting ejected after the privnet ingress tighten at 11:02. Kubelet shows `connection reset by peer` to control-plane and then NodeEvicted. Anyone else?

anya: yep, saw ~7 evictions across two AZs. Firewall logs show L4 RSTs to 100.64.0.0/16:10250 from our L7 edge.

claire: that CIDR is the control-plane pod network. The new rule intended to block cross-tenant ingress accidentally matched `privnet-ingress` because of a CIDR overlap in the rule set.

noah: minimal trace: ```
11:12:05 kubelet: kubelet: failed to post status -> dial tcp 100.64.1.23:10250: connection reset by peer
11:12:07 node-exporter: node lost: NodeEvicted: network unreachable
```

sre-oncall: impact: ~14 GPU-minutes lost, autoscaler tried rebalancing and briefly drained warm pools. Marking SEV-4. Quick fix: add allow rule for control-plane CIDR or narrow offending L7 match.

anya: can we scope the L7 rule to app labels instead of broad CIDR match? That would avoid catching internal control-plane ranges.

claire: agree. For immediate mitigation I'm adding an exception for 100.64.0.0/16 -> 10.0.0.0/16:10250 (control-plane) in ap-south2 only. Ops-bot create CR with auto-expire 1h.

sec-bot: Change request CR-2026-221 created: "ap-south2 L7 allow: control-plane -> nodeport 10250 (temp)". Approvers: @claire, @noah. Auto-expire: 1h.

noah: applied. Nodes rejoining, evictions stopped. Good short-term signal.

anya: postmortem items: (1) fix rule generator to avoid CIDR overlaps (P0), (2) add preflight that simulates control-plane traffic (P0), (3) tighten L7 match on app labels (P1).

claire: cost note: warm-pool drains caused ~30s extra spin-up on a handful of jobs, estimated $40 in extra spot fallback for the hour. Add to PM.

sre-oncall: monitoring for 30m, will close SEV-4 if stable. Reminder: do not roll out L7 tighten globally until preflight is added.

noah: thanks all. Filing PM-2026-622 and attaching CR + firewall rule diffs. :thumbsup:
